items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I met my Honey... I didn't want her to forget me, so I sent her a dozen roses... I tell my Honey

ctx.x: Yeah, so I -- know, I went there and I stayed there for maybe 3, 4 -- how long was I there, Honey? 3 or 4 years? MOODY, LINDA: You were up there -- you were there till through almost '89 -- '88.
Yeah, until, until. MOODY, LINDA: So. This would be maybe '85, '86, '87.
